items.title: 时间状语从句 when/while/as 的辨析
items.brief: 时点用 when，时段用 while，同步用 as

concept.summary: 三条判据按顺序用：从句给的是主句动作发生的时间点，用 when；从句给的是主句动作持续的时间段，用 while；两个动作同时推进、后者随前者变化，用 as。判据的落点是谓语动词的持续长度——瞬间动词只能提供时点，延续性动词才能提供时段。

sections.p: 先看从句谓语是瞬间动词还是延续性动词，再看两个动作是“打断”还是“并行”，最后看有没有“随着”的比例关系。三者对应 when、while、as，顺序不能颠倒。
bullets: when：从句动作是一个时点，主句动作在此时点发生或被打断；谓语多为 went out、arrived、rang、heard 这类瞬间动词
while：从句动作占据一段时间，主句动作在这段时间内持续；谓语必须是延续性动词，通常是进行时或状态动词
as：两个动作同时推进，常译“随着”“一边……一边”，从句谓语多为 grow、become、increase 这类表变化的动词

sections.p: while 的语义是“在整段时间里”，所以从句谓语必须能延续。瞬间动词无法铺满一段时间，放进 while 从句后句子不成立，这不是习惯问题，而是体（aspect）与连词语义冲突。
bullets: √ While I was preparing dinner, the phone rang.
× While she heard the news, she burst into tears.（heard 是瞬间动作，改 When）
主语一致时可省略为 while doing：While walking home, I met an old friend.

sections.p: as 的核心不是“同时”，而是“同步”：两个过程按同一节奏推进，或一个人在做一个动作的过程中做另一个动作。表示“随着……越来越……”时只能用 as，while 没有这个含义。
bullets: As he grew older, he became more patient.（年龄增长与耐心增长同步）
As the temperature rises, the ice melts faster.
as 还可表“一边……一边”：He whistled as he walked.

examples.en: When the lights went out, the audience gasped.
examples.zh: 灯灭的那一刻，观众倒吸了一口气。
examples.note: went out 是瞬间动作，只提供一个时点，用 when。

examples.en: While I was preparing dinner, the phone rang three times.
examples.zh: 我做饭的时候，电话响了三次。
examples.note: was preparing 是延续性动作，构成一段时间背景，用 while。

examples.en: As the temperature rises, the ice melts faster.
examples.zh: 随着温度升高，冰融化得更快。
examples.note: 温度上升与融化加速同步推进，构成比例关系，用 as。

examples.en: While she heard the news, she burst into tears.
examples.zh: 她听到消息就哭了。
examples.note: heard 是瞬间动词，不能铺满 while 要求的时段，应改为 When she heard the news。

examples.en: While the train arrived, we were waiting on the platform.
examples.zh: 火车到站时，我们正在站台上等。
examples.note: arrived 是瞬间动作，无法充当持续背景，应改为 When the train arrived。

examples.en: While my brother prefers tea, I drink coffee every morning.
examples.zh: 我弟弟喜欢茶，而我每天早上喝咖啡。
examples.note: while 在此表对比“而”，不表时间，两边都可以是状态动词。

examples.en: As he grew older, he became more patient with his students.
examples.zh: 随着年龄增长，他对学生越来越有耐心。
examples.note: grow 与 become 同步变化，用 as 而不能用 while。

pitfalls.wrong: While he heard the doorbell, he opened the door.
pitfalls.right: When he heard the doorbell, he opened the door.
pitfalls.why: heard 是瞬间动作，不能构成 while 所需的持续时段；时点由 when 承担。

pitfalls.wrong: While he grew older, he became more patient.
pitfalls.right: As he grew older, he became more patient.
pitfalls.why: while 只说明两个动作在时间上重叠，不表达“随着”的比例变化，同步变化必须用 as。

pitfalls.wrong: I was reading while the phone rang.
pitfalls.right: I was reading when the phone rang.
pitfalls.why: while 从句应提供一段持续背景，rang 是打断背景的瞬间动作，只能用 when。

contrast.diff: 本点只切分“同时”内部的三分（时点、时段、同步）；before/after/until 处理先后顺序与终点，靠动作发生的次序判断。

concept.mnemonic: 点用 when，段用 while，变用 as；先看动词能不能延续，再看两动作是否同步。

core: when：从句给时点，谓语多为瞬间动词，主句动作在此点发生或被打断
while：从句给时段，谓语必须是延续性动词或进行时
as：两过程同步推进，可译“随着”“一边……一边”
while 另有对比义“而”，此时不表时间
判断顺序：先看从句动词是点还是段，再看是否同步变化
review.trigger: 空格后是从句且句中有两个动作 → 先看从句谓语能延续多久 → 点选 when、段选 while、同步变化选 as

quickCheck.q: While he ___ (knock) at the door, I was cooking. 这句能成立吗？
quickCheck.a: 不能。knocked 是瞬间动作，应改为 When he knocked at the door, I was cooking.

quickCheck.q: “随着他年龄增长，他变得更有耐心”用哪个连词？
quickCheck.a: as。这是同步变化，while 不表此义。

quickCheck.q: while 除了时间还能表达什么关系？
quickCheck.a: 对比“而”，如 While he likes tea, I prefer coffee.

drills.stem: ___ the goalkeeper caught the ball, the referee blew his whistle.
drills.explain: caught 是瞬间动词，只提供一个时点，主句的 blew 就在这一时点发生，因此用 when；while 需要从句谓语能延续。
drills.trap: While 是最强干扰项，学生只记住“当……时候”就套用，忽略了 while 要求从句动词可持续。

drills.stem: As she ___ (grow) older, she became more tolerant of other people's mistakes.
accept: grew
drills.hint: 主句 became 是过去时，从句的同步变化也要用过去时。
drills.explain: as 表两个过程同步推进，主句用 became，从句的 grow 同样用一般过去时 grew，构成“随着年龄增长，她越来越宽容”。

drills.stem: While the fire alarm rang, the students were taking an exam.
drills.answer: When the fire alarm rang, the students were taking an exam.
accept: When the fire alarm rang, the students were taking an exam.
As the fire alarm rang, the students were taking an exam.
drills.explain: rang 是瞬间动作，只能给时点，不能充当 while 需要的持续背景；改用 when（或表同时的 as）后，主句的过去进行时正好表示被警报打断的持续动作。

drills.stem: ___ her sister is outgoing, Jane prefers to spend evenings alone with a book.
drills.explain: 两句是性格对比，while 在此表“而”，属于对比用法而非时间用法，两边都可以是状态动词。
drills.trap: As soon as 与 The moment 都要求主句动作发生在从句动作之后，本句没有先后关系，只是并列对比。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: As he grew older, he became more patient.
drills.explain: as 引导的从句置于句首，主句在后；grew 与 became 同为过去时，体现两个过程的同步推进。

drills.stem: 我正沿着河边散步，这时遇到了多年未见的老同学。
drills.answer: I was walking along the river when I met an old classmate I had not seen for years.
drills.explain: 主句是持续的过去进行时，met 是突然打断这一背景的瞬间动作，因此用 when 而不能用 while。

items.title: 时间状语从句中的主将从现
items.brief: 状语从句表将来用现在时，主句才用 will

concept.summary: 时间、条件、让步状语从句指将来时，从句谓语降为一般现在时，完成意义降为现在完成时，主句才用 will、be going to 或祈使句。判据是“从句连词管的是状语还是其他成分”：when、if、unless、until、as soon as、before、after、even if 引导状语从句时一律不用 will。

sections.p: 所谓“主将从现”不是把将来时换成现在时，而是同一时间意义换一种表达：从句用现在时系统承担将来所指，主句照常保留将来标记。
bullets: will do → do / does：I will call you when I arrive.
will have done → have / has done：We will start when everyone has arrived.
will be doing → is / are doing（较少）：He will feel better when he is resting.
主句可用 will、be going to、情态动词或祈使句：Tell me as soon as you decide.

sections.p: 这条规则只管状语从句。一旦从句在主句中充当主语、宾语或定语，它就不是状语，将来意义照常用 will。判断方法是问“这个从句能不能移到句首作状语”。
bullets: 宾语从句：I don't know whether he will join us.（whether 从句作 know 的宾语）
主语从句：When he will arrive is still unknown.（when 从句作主语）
if 表“是否”时同样是宾语从句：She asked if I would stay.

sections.p: 即便记住了规则，以下三处仍会出错：从句主语的第三人称单数、until 从句的完成意义、as soon as 与现在完成时的搭配。
bullets: 从句主语第三人称单数要加 s：He will call you when he gets home.
until 强调“到……为止已完成”用现在完成时：Wait here until I have finished.
as soon as 两个动作紧接，常用一般现在时即可：I will leave as soon as the meeting ends.

examples.en: I will call you as soon as I arrive at the airport.
examples.zh: 我一到机场就给你打电话。
examples.note: as soon as 引导时间状语从句指将来，从句用一般现在时 arrive。

examples.en: If it rains tomorrow, the match will be put off.
examples.zh: 如果明天下雨，比赛将推迟。
examples.note: if 条件从句用一般现在时表示将来，主句保留 will。

examples.en: We will not start the meeting until everyone has arrived.
examples.zh: 等所有人都到齐，我们才开会。
examples.note: until 从句强调“到那时已完成”，用现在完成时替代将来完成时。

examples.en: I will call you as soon as I will arrive at the airport.
examples.zh: 我一到机场就给你打电话。
examples.note: 时间状语从句不能用 will 表将来，应改为 as soon as I arrive。

examples.en: I do not know if it will rain, but if it will rain, we will stay at home.
examples.zh: 我不知道会不会下雨，但如果下雨，我们就待在家里。
examples.note: 第一个 if 表“是否”，是宾语从句，用 will 正确；第二个 if 是条件状语从句，须改为 if it rains。

examples.en: I do not know whether he will join us for dinner.
examples.zh: 我不知道他会不会来和我们一起吃晚饭。
examples.note: whether 从句作 know 的宾语，属于名词性从句，将来意义照常用 will。

examples.en: When he will arrive is still unknown.
examples.zh: 他什么时候到仍然不清楚。
examples.note: when 从句在此作主语，是主语从句，不受主将从现约束。

pitfalls.wrong: We will go out when the rain will stop.
pitfalls.right: We will go out when the rain stops.
pitfalls.why: when 引导的是时间状语从句，将来意义由一般现在时承担，主句才用 will。

pitfalls.wrong: I will wait here until he will come back.
pitfalls.right: I will wait here until he comes back.
pitfalls.why: until 从句指将来的终点，同样降级为一般现在时；用 will 会造成两个将来标记并存。

pitfalls.wrong: He will tell you the truth if he will know it.
pitfalls.right: He will tell you the truth if he knows it.
pitfalls.why: 条件从句里 will 只表意愿，不表将来；此处是纯粹的将来条件，必须用一般现在时。

contrast.withTitle: 宾语从句的语序与时态
contrast.diff: 主将从现只约束状语从句；宾语从句表示将来时照常用 will，且要用陈述语序，两者的判断入口分别是“从句能否移到句首”和“主句动词是否需要宾语”。

concept.mnemonic: 从句让位，主句带队；状语从句讲将来，谓语退回现在时。

core: 适用：时间（when/before/after/until/as soon as）、条件（if/unless）、让步（even if）状语从句
替换：will do → do/does；will have done → have/has done
主句照常用 will、be going to、情态动词或祈使句
不适用：宾语从句、主语从句、定语从句，以及 if 表“是否”
从句主语第三人称单数别忘了加 s
判据：从句能移到句首作状语 → 受主将从现约束
review.trigger: 从句连词 + 将来意义 → 先把从句谓语降为现在时 → 再回头看主句是否保留了 will

quickCheck.q: I will tell him the news as soon as he ___ (come) back. 填什么？
quickCheck.a: comes。时间状语从句用一般现在时表将来。

quickCheck.q: I don't know whether he ___ (come). 填什么？
quickCheck.a: will come。whether 从句是宾语从句，不受主将从现约束。

quickCheck.q: until 从句要表达“到那时已完成”，用什么时态？
quickCheck.a: 现在完成时，如 until everyone has arrived。

drills.stem: We will not leave the classroom until the rain ___.
drills.explain: until 引导时间状语从句，主句用 will not leave 表将来，从句必须降为一般现在时 stops。
drills.trap: will stop 是汉语“直到雨会停”的逐字翻译，两个将来标记不能同时出现在主从结构里。

drills.stem: As soon as the report ___ (finish), it will be sent to the manager.
accept: is finished
has been finished
drills.hint: report 是被完成的，从句要用被动；主句已经是 will be sent。
drills.explain: 时间状语从句指将来，用一般现在时的被动 is finished；强调“完成之后”也可用现在完成时的被动 has been finished。

drills.stem: I will call you as soon as I will get the results.
drills.answer: I will call you as soon as I get the results.
accept: I will call you as soon as I get the results.
drills.explain: as soon as 引导时间状语从句，从句不能用 will 表将来，改为一般现在时 get；将来标记只保留在主句 will call 上。

drills.stem: Nobody knows when the spacecraft ___ the moon next year.
drills.explain: 这里的 when 从句作 knows 的宾语，是宾语从句而不是时间状语从句，将来意义必须用 will reach；next year 也印证了将来时间。
drills.trap: reaches 是把主将从现机械套用到宾语从句的典型错误，本句从句无法移到句首作状语。

drills.stem: 如果明天天气好，我们就去爬山。
drills.answer: If the weather is fine tomorrow, we will go climbing.
drills.explain: if 引导条件状语从句，从句用一般现在时 is fine 表将来，主句保留 will go；两个将来标记不能都放在从句里。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: I will call you as soon as I arrive at the airport.
drills.explain: 主句用 will call 表将来，as soon as 从句用一般现在时 arrive，构成标准的主将从现结构。

items.title: 地点状语从句
items.brief: where 前无先行词即为地点状语从句

concept.summary: where 引导地点状语从句时，主句中没有表示地点的先行词，where 自身等于 in/at/to the place，从句说明动作发生或指向的地点。判定只有一条：where 前有没有地点名词作先行词——有则是定语从句，可换成 in which；没有则是状语从句，不能换成 in which。

sections.p: 把 where 前面的成分看一遍，若紧邻的是一个地点名词且这个名词在主句中充当成分，where 从句修饰它，是定语从句；若 where 直接跟在动词或介词之后，前面没有可修饰的地点名词，就是状语从句。
bullets: Put the book where it belongs.（无先行词 → 地点状语从句）
Put the book on the shelf where it belongs.（shelf 是先行词 → 定语从句，可换 on which）
He works where the air is clean.（无先行词 → 状语从句，不能换成 in which）

sections.p: 表示“无论哪里”用 wherever，它引导的仍是地点状语从句，可置于句首；where 还可构成 where possible、where necessary 这类省略结构，相当于 where it is possible。
bullets: Wherever she goes, she carries a notebook.
You may sit wherever you like.（= in any place you like）
Add a comma where necessary.（= where it is necessary）

sections.p: where 本身是地点副词，已经在从句中充当状语，因此不能再被 in、at、to 支配；它也不能与 that 叠加使用。这两点是写作中最常见的结构错误。
bullets: × in where / × at where / × to where（表示“往……”时 where 已含 to）
× You may sit wherever that you like.（wherever 已是连词）
√ 从句可前置：Where there is a will, there is a way.

examples.en: Put the chair where you found it.
examples.zh: 把椅子放回你找到它的地方。
examples.note: where 前没有地点名词，从句直接作 put 的地点状语。

examples.en: Where there is a will, there is a way.
examples.zh: 有志者事竟成。
examples.note: 地点状语从句置于句首，主句在后，两个 there be 结构各自完整。

examples.en: Wherever she goes, she carries a notebook.
examples.zh: 她走到哪里都带着一个笔记本。
examples.note: wherever 表“无论哪里”，引导让步性质的地点状语从句。

examples.en: Leave the package where the guard can see it.
examples.zh: 把包裹放在保安能看到的地方。
examples.note: where 从句修饰 leave 的地点，前面没有先行词。

examples.en: I found my keys in where I had left them.
examples.zh: 我在原来放钥匙的地方找到了钥匙。
examples.note: where 已含 in，前面不能再加介词，应改为 I found my keys where I had left them.

examples.en: Where he went, he made friends with the local people.
examples.zh: 无论走到哪里，他都和当地人交朋友。
examples.note: 此处是“无论哪里”的概括意义，须用 Wherever he went。

examples.en: Add a comma where necessary.
examples.zh: 在必要的地方加逗号。
examples.note: where necessary 是 where it is necessary 的省略形式，仍属地点状语从句。

pitfalls.wrong: He put the box in where it was dry.
pitfalls.right: He put the box where it was dry.
pitfalls.why: where 等于 in the place，本身已带介词，再加 in 会造成介词重复。

pitfalls.wrong: Where he went, he made friends easily.
pitfalls.right: Wherever he went, he made friends easily.
pitfalls.why: where 指一个确定地点，表示“无论哪里”的概括意义必须用 wherever。

pitfalls.wrong: You may sit wherever that you like.
pitfalls.right: You may sit wherever you like.
pitfalls.why: wherever 已经是引导从句的连词，不能再叠加 that，否则从句出现两个引导词。

contrast.withTitle: 关系副词 when/where/why 的选用
contrast.diff: 定语从句的 where 前必有地点先行词，可用 in which 替换；地点状语从句的 where 前没有先行词，不能换成 in which。

concept.mnemonic: where 前找名词：找到是定语，找不到是状语；where 自带介词，别再补 in。

core: where 前无地点名词 → 地点状语从句；有 → 定语从句
where = in/at/to the place，因此不能再加 in/at/to
wherever = 无论哪里，可置于句首
where 从句位置灵活：Where there is a will, there is a way.
省略形式：where possible / where necessary
状语从句不能换成 in which，定语从句可以
review.trigger: 看到 where → 往前找一个地点名词 → 找到就按定语从句处理，找不到就按地点状语从句处理

quickCheck.q: Put it where you like. 中 where 引导什么从句？
quickCheck.a: 地点状语从句，前面没有先行词。

quickCheck.q: the house where I grew up 中 where 引导什么从句？
quickCheck.a: 定语从句，house 是先行词，可换成 in which。

quickCheck.q: where 前面能加 in 吗？
quickCheck.a: 不能。where 本身等于 in the place，加 in 会重复。

drills.stem: The medicine should be kept ___ children cannot reach it.
drills.explain: 前面没有地点名词作先行词，从句直接说明 kept 的地点，用 where 引导地点状语从句。
drills.trap: in which 只在定语从句中替代 where，本句没有先行词，无法使用；which 与 that 需要先行词或成分空缺。

drills.stem: ___ you go, remember to send me a postcard.
accept: Wherever
drills.hint: 表示“无论哪里”，不是某一个确定地点。
drills.explain: 句意是“无论你到哪里”，需要表概括地点的 wherever；where 只能指一个确定地点，无法与 you go 构成泛指。

drills.stem: He put the box in where it was dry.
drills.answer: He put the box where it was dry.
accept: He put the box where it was dry.
drills.explain: where 相当于 in the place，本身已包含介词，前面再加 in 会造成介词重复；删去 in 后从句直接作 put 的地点状语。

drills.stem: This is the village ___ we stayed last summer.
drills.explain: village 是地点先行词，从句中 stayed 是不及物动词、不缺宾语，缺的是地点状语，因此用关系副词 where，等于 in which。
drills.trap: which 与 that 必须在从句中充当主语或宾语，而 stayed 后已有完整结构，选它们会造成成分悬空。

drills.stem: 把书放回你原来拿的地方。
drills.answer: Put the book back where you took it.
drills.explain: where 引导地点状语从句，自身等于 to the place，因此前面不能再加 in 或 to；take 的过去式 took 与主句祈使语气搭配。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: Wherever he goes, he makes new friends.
drills.explain: wherever 引导的地点状语从句置于句首，主句用一般现在时表习惯，两个分句各有完整主谓。

items.title: 原因状语从句
items.brief: because 给新信息，since 给已知前提

concept.summary: 原因从句按“原因是不是听话人已知的信息”分三层：because 提供新信息、语气最强，可回答 why，也可作强调句的焦点；since 与 as 把原因当作已知前提，译“既然、由于”，多置于句首；now that 表示“既然现在已经……”，隐含情况发生了变化。for 是并列连词，只补充推断依据，不能置句首。

sections.p: 判断用哪个词，先问这个原因对方知不知道。对方不知道、正是我要告诉他的信息，用 because；双方都清楚、只是拿它当下文的前提，用 since 或 as。
bullets: because：回答 why、可作强调句焦点（It was because...that...）、位置灵活
since / as：原因已知，通常前置；不能回答 why
now that：强调“现在情况变了”，只能指现在

sections.p: 汉语的“因为……所以……”在英语里只能保留一个标记。because 是从属连词，so 是并列连词，两者同时出现会让同一因果关系被标记两次。另外 because of 是介词短语，后面只能接名词性成分。
bullets: × Because he was ill, so he stayed at home.
√ Because he was ill, he stayed at home. / He was ill, so he stayed at home.
× because of + 从句；√ because of + 名词 / 动名词

sections.p: for 引导的是并列分句，作用是补充一个推断依据，语气最弱，且不能置于句首。判断方法是：把它换成 because 后句子是否仍然自然；若只是“由此推断”，就只能用 for。
bullets: He must be out, for the lights are off.（由灯灭推断他不在）
× For the lights were off, he was out.
书面变体：seeing that / considering that + 从句

examples.en: He was late because the subway broke down.
examples.zh: 他迟到了，因为地铁出了故障。
examples.note: 地铁故障是听话人不知道的新信息，用 because 直接给出原因。

examples.en: Since you have finished your work, you may leave early.
examples.zh: 既然你完成了工作，可以早点走。
examples.note: “你完成了工作”是双方都清楚的前提，用 since 引出结论。

examples.en: Now that everyone is here, let's begin.
examples.zh: 既然大家都到齐了，我们开始吧。
examples.note: now that 强调情况刚刚发生变化，只能指现在。

examples.en: It was because the road was blocked that we missed the flight.
examples.zh: 正是因为道路被封，我们才错过了航班。
examples.note: because 从句可作强调句的焦点，since 与 as 不能进入这一结构。

examples.en: He must be out, for the lights are off.
examples.zh: 他肯定出门了，因为灯是灭的。
examples.note: for 分句只是推断依据，不能换成 because 提前。

examples.en: Because he was ill, so he did not attend the meeting.
examples.zh: 因为生病，他没有参加会议。
examples.note: because 与 so 不能同时标记同一因果关系，删去 so 或将 because 从句改为独立分句。

examples.en: Because of he was ill, he did not attend the meeting.
examples.zh: 因为生病，他没有参加会议。
examples.note: because of 是介词短语，后面不能接主谓结构，应改为 Because he was ill 或 because of his illness。

pitfalls.wrong: Since he was ill, so he stayed at home.
pitfalls.right: Since he was ill, he stayed at home.
pitfalls.why: since 已标明原因，so 再标结果会让同一逻辑关系出现两个连接词，英语只保留一个。

pitfalls.wrong: Because of the weather was bad, the flight was cancelled.
pitfalls.right: Because the weather was bad, the flight was cancelled.
pitfalls.why: because of 后只能接名词性成分；后面是完整主谓结构时必须用连词 because。

pitfalls.wrong: Why did you leave so early? — Since I was tired.
pitfalls.right: Why did you leave so early? — Because I was tired.
pitfalls.why: since 把原因当作双方已知的前提，无法承担答句中“新信息”的功能，回答 why 只能用 because。

contrast.diff: because 说明已经发生的事实的原因；so that 说明做某事想要达到的目的，从句带情态动词，两者不能互换。

concept.mnemonic: 新信息用 because，已知前提用 since，补充推断用 for；because 与 so 不同框。

core: because：直接原因、新信息，可回答 why，可作强调句焦点
since / as：原因视为已知前提，多前置，不能回答 why
now that：既然现在……，隐含情况变化，只指现在
for 是并列连词，只补充推断依据，不能置句首
because 与 so 不能同现；because of 后接名词性成分
review.trigger: 要写“因为” → 先问对方是否已经知道这个原因 → 不知道用 because，已知用 since/as，推断用 for

quickCheck.q: 回答 Why...? 只能用哪个连词？
quickCheck.a: because。

quickCheck.q: Because he was ill, so he stayed at home. 错在哪里？
quickCheck.a: because 与 so 重复标记同一因果关系，只能留一个。

quickCheck.q: because of 后面能接从句吗？
quickCheck.a: 不能。它后面只能接名词、代词或动名词。

drills.stem: The match was cancelled ___ the heavy rain.
drills.explain: 空格后只有名词短语 the heavy rain，没有主谓结构，必须用介词短语 because of；其余三个都是连词，后面要接从句。
drills.trap: because 是最强干扰项，学生只记“因为”的词义，忽略了空后是名词短语而非从句。

drills.stem: It was ___ the traffic was heavy that we arrived late.
drills.explain: 这是 it was...that 强调句，被强调的部分是原因状语从句；只有 because 能作强调句的焦点，since、as、for 都不能。
drills.trap: since 与 as 也能表原因，但它们在语义上把原因当作已知前提，无法成为被强调的新信息。

drills.stem: ___ the exam is over, we can relax for a while.
accept: Now that
now that
drills.hint: 强调“既然现在已经……”，暗示情况刚刚改变。
drills.explain: 考试结束是一个刚刚发生的变化，用 now that 引出“既然如此”的结论，比 since 更能体现时间上的转折。

drills.stem: Because the road was blocked, so we had to take another route.
drills.answer: Because the road was blocked, we had to take another route.
accept: Because the road was blocked, we had to take another route.
The road was blocked, so we had to take another route.
drills.explain: because 与 so 不能同时出现：前者是从属连词，后者是并列连词，同一个因果关系只能由一个连接词标记。

drills.stem: 他因为生病没来上课。
drills.answer: He did not come to class because he was ill.
drills.explain: “生病”是听话人不知道的新信息，用 because 引导从句；同时不能加 so，也不能用 because of 接主谓结构。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: It was because the road was blocked that we missed the flight.
drills.explain: 强调句结构 it was...that 中被强调的成分是 because 从句，去掉 it was 与 that 后句子仍完整，说明结构成立。

items.title: 目的状语从句
items.brief: 目的从句带情态动词，so that 不置句首

concept.summary: 目的从句由 so that、in order that、lest、for fear that 引导，从句谓语几乎总带 can/could/may/might/will/would 或 should，这个情态动词就是“目的”的标记。判据：从句有情态动词且表“为了能够”→ 目的；从句无情态动词、陈述已发生的事实 → 结果。

sections.p: so that 最常用，但不能置于句首；in order that 更书面，可以置于句首；lest 与 for fear that 表否定目的“以免”，从句用 should + 动词原形，should 可省略。
bullets: She spoke slowly so that everyone could follow her.
In order that the samples would not be damaged, they were packed in foam.
Take an umbrella lest it (should) rain.

sections.p: 目的在说话时尚未实现，所以从句要用情态动词表示“能够、可以”。一旦从句改用陈述语气陈述实际发生的事，句子就变成结果，语义也随之改变。
bullets: 目的：He got up early so that he could catch the first bus.
结果：He got up early, so he caught the first bus.
so that 引导结果时常有逗号，引导目的时通常不加逗号

sections.h: 否定目的与非谓语替换
sections.p: 否定目的在从句内否定：so that...not；若主从句主语一致，可换成非谓语 in order not to / so as not to。注意 so as to 不能置于句首，in order to 可以。
bullets: She whispered so that she would not wake the baby.
She whispered so as not to wake the baby.
× so that to do；so that 后面必须是从句

examples.en: She spoke slowly so that everyone could follow her.
examples.zh: 她说得很慢，好让每个人都能跟上。
examples.note: could 表明这是尚未实现的目的，so that 引导目的状语从句。

examples.en: In order that the samples would not be damaged, they were packed in foam.
examples.zh: 为了不使样品受损，它们被用泡沫包装起来。
examples.note: in order that 可置于句首，从句用 would not 表否定目的。

examples.en: He studied hard so as to pass the exam.
examples.zh: 他努力学习以通过考试。
examples.note: 主从句主语一致时可用 so as to 不定式替换目的从句。

examples.en: Take an umbrella with you lest it should rain.
examples.zh: 带把伞，以防下雨。
examples.note: lest 表否定目的，从句用 should + 原形，should 也可省略。

examples.en: She spoke slowly so that everyone can follow her.
examples.zh: 她说得很慢，好让每个人都能跟上。
examples.note: 主句是过去时 spoke，目的从句的情态动词须相应用 could，保持时态呼应。

examples.en: He studied hard so that to pass the exam.
examples.zh: 他努力学习以通过考试。
examples.note: so that 后面必须接完整从句，接不定式要用 so as to 或 in order to。

pitfalls.wrong: He got up early so that he could caught the train.
pitfalls.right: He got up early so that he could catch the train.
pitfalls.why: 情态动词 could 后必须接动词原形，caught 是过去式，不能跟在情态动词之后。

pitfalls.wrong: He studied hard so that to pass the exam.
pitfalls.right: He studied hard so that he could pass the exam.
pitfalls.why: so that 是从属连词，只能引导从句；要接不定式必须换成 so as to。

pitfalls.wrong: Lest he will miss the train, he left home early.
pitfalls.right: Lest he should miss the train, he left home early.
pitfalls.why: lest 后的谓语固定为 should + 原形（should 可省），不能用 will 表将来。

contrast.withTitle: 结果状语从句 so...that 与 such...that
contrast.diff: 目的从句带情态动词、动作尚未发生；结果从句不带情态动词、陈述已经发生的事实，这是区分两者的唯一可靠标志。

concept.mnemonic: 目的带情态，结果带逗号；so that 不抬头，in order that 可前置。

core: 引导词：so that / in order that / lest / for fear that
目的标记：从句带 can/could/may/might/will/would/should
so that 不置句首；in order that 可置句首
lest / for fear that 后接 should + 原形，should 可省
否定目的：so that...not；非谓语用 in order not to / so as not to
so that 后不能直接接不定式
review.trigger: 看到“为了/以便” → 先写从句 → 给从句补一个情态动词 → 再检查主句时态是否呼应

quickCheck.q: so that 后面能直接接动词原形吗？
quickCheck.a: 不能。so that 后必须是从句；接不定式要用 so as to。

quickCheck.q: lest 后面的谓语怎么构成？
quickCheck.a: should + 动词原形，should 可以省略。

quickCheck.q: 目的从句和结果从句怎么一眼分开？
quickCheck.a: 目的从句带情态动词，结果从句不带且常与逗号同现。

drills.stem: She whispered ___ wake the sleeping baby.
drills.explain: 空后是动词原形 wake，没有主语，只能用不定式结构；否定目的用 so as not to，也可用 in order not to。
drills.trap: so that not to 把从句连词与不定式混在一起，so that 后必须接完整的主谓结构。

drills.stem: He left the door open ___ the cat could come in.
drills.explain: 空后是完整从句 the cat could come in，需要从属连词 so that；could 正是目的从句的情态标记。
drills.trap: so as to 与 in order to 后面只能接动词原形，不能接主谓结构；lest 表否定目的，与 could come in 的肯定意义冲突。

drills.stem: He wrote down my address ___ he should forget it.
accept: lest
drills.hint: 填一个词，表示“以免”，后面接 should + 原形。
drills.explain: lest 引导否定目的从句，谓语用 should forget，should 也可省略为 lest he forget it。

drills.stem: She spoke slowly so that everyone can follow her.
drills.answer: She spoke slowly so that everyone could follow her.
accept: She spoke slowly so that everyone could follow her.
drills.explain: 主句谓语是过去时 spoke，目的从句的情态动词要相应用 could，构成时态呼应；can 会把目的拉到现在的语境。

drills.stem: 为了提高口语，她每天大声朗读。
drills.answer: She reads aloud every day so that she can improve her spoken English.
drills.explain: 目的从句用 so that 引导，从句补情态动词 can 表“能够”，主句用一般现在时表习惯。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: He got up early so that he could catch the first bus.
drills.explain: so that 引导目的状语从句，从句用 could catch 与主句 got up 的过去时呼应。

items.title: 结果状语从句 so...that 与 such...that
items.brief: 看 that 前紧邻成分：形容词用 so，名词用 such

concept.summary: 选用只看 that 前面紧挨着什么：紧挨形容词或副词用 so + adj/adv + that；紧挨名词短语用 such + (a/an) + adj + n + that。唯一的例外是数量限定词 many、much、few、little，它们本身被 so 修饰，构成 so many/much/few/little + 名词 + that。

sections.p: 把 that 前面的部分读一遍：如果最后一个词是形容词或副词，用 so；如果最后一个词是名词，用 such，并检查名词前有没有 a/an。判定不需要理解句意，只看词性。
bullets: so + adj/adv：The box was so heavy that nobody could lift it.
such + a/an + adj + n：It was such a heavy box that nobody could lift it.
such + adj + 复数/不可数名词：such fine weather, such interesting books

sections.p: many、much、few、little 是限定词，作用相当于数量，被 so 修饰，所以即使后面有名词也用 so。little 有歧义：表“少”用 so little，表“小”用 such little。
bullets: so many people / so much money / so few mistakes / so little time
such little children（little = 年纪小）
such a lot of people（a lot of 是量词短语，整体被 such 修饰）

sections.p: so + adj + a/an + n 与 such + a/an + adj + n 同义，前者更书面。so 置于句首时主句要部分倒装，这是考试中的高频句式。
bullets: It was so good a film that I watched it twice. = It was such a good film that...
So tired was he that he fell asleep at once.（so 置句首 → 倒装）
结果从句的 that 在口语中可省略，书面语建议保留

examples.en: The box was so heavy that nobody could lift it.
examples.zh: 箱子太重了，没人能抬起来。
examples.note: that 前紧邻形容词 heavy，用 so 修饰。

examples.en: It was such a heavy box that nobody could lift it.
examples.zh: 那是一个重得没人抬得起的箱子。
examples.note: that 前是名词短语 a heavy box，用 such 修饰整个名词短语。

examples.en: So many people came that the hall was full.
examples.zh: 来了太多人，大厅都满了。
examples.note: many 是数量限定词，被 so 修饰，构成 so many + 复数名词。

examples.en: It was so good a film that I watched it twice.
examples.zh: 那部电影太好了，我看了两遍。
examples.note: so + 形容词 + a/an + 名词是 such a good film 的书面变体。

examples.en: They are such little children that they cannot dress themselves.
examples.zh: 他们太小了，还不能自己穿衣服。
examples.note: little 在此表“年纪小”，修饰名词，用 such。

examples.en: It was so a moving story that everyone cried.
examples.zh: 那是一个感人的故事，大家都哭了。
examples.note: so 不能直接修饰 a + 形容词 + 名词，应改为 such a moving story 或 so moving a story。

examples.en: I have never seen such a beautiful scenery.
examples.zh: 我从没见过这么美的风景。
examples.note: scenery 是不可数名词，不能加 a，应改为 such beautiful scenery。

examples.en: It was so cold weather that we stayed indoors.
examples.zh: 天气太冷了，我们待在室内。
examples.note: that 前紧邻名词 weather，须用 such cold weather；so 只能修饰形容词 cold，不能带出名词。

pitfalls.wrong: There were such many students that the room was crowded.
pitfalls.right: There were so many students that the room was crowded.
pitfalls.why: many 是数量限定词，被 so 修饰构成 so many；such 只能修饰名词短语本身。

pitfalls.wrong: He is so a kind man that everyone likes him.
pitfalls.right: He is such a kind man that everyone likes him.
pitfalls.why: so 与 a/an 不能直接相邻，such 才能带出 a + 形容词 + 名词的整体结构。

pitfalls.wrong: The film was such interesting that we watched it twice.
pitfalls.right: The film was so interesting that we watched it twice.
pitfalls.why: such 后面必须出现名词，interesting 是形容词，缺少名词时只能用 so。

contrast.diff: 结果从句陈述已经发生的事实、不带情态动词；目的从句用情态动词表示尚未实现的目标。

concept.mnemonic: 看 that 前一站：形容词下车用 so，名词下车用 such；数量词永远跟 so 走。

core: 判据：that 前紧邻形容词/副词 → so；紧邻名词短语 → such
语序：so + adj/adv + that；such + a/an + adj + n + that
so + adj + a/an + n = such + a/an + adj + n（前者更书面）
数量词例外：so many/much/few/little + 名词
little 表“少”用 so，表“小”用 such
so 置句首时主句部分倒装
review.trigger: 看到 that 前要选 so 还是 such → 只看紧挨 that 的那个词是形容词还是名词 → 名词再查有没有 a/an

quickCheck.q: so many 还是 such many？
quickCheck.a: so many，many 是数量限定词。

quickCheck.q: such little children 中的 little 是什么意思？
quickCheck.a: 年纪小，修饰名词，所以用 such。

quickCheck.q: “这么好的电影”两种写法？
quickCheck.a: such a good film / so good a film。

drills.stem: It was ___ that we decided to stay another day.
drills.explain: so 修饰形容词 beautiful，后接 a + 名词构成 so beautiful a place，是 such a beautiful place 的书面变体。
drills.trap: such beautiful a place 把 such 与 a 的固定语序颠倒，such 必须紧接 a/an；such beautiful place 则缺少冠词。

drills.stem: There were ___ mistakes in the report that it had to be rewritten.
drills.explain: mistakes 是可数名词复数，many 是数量限定词被 so 修饰，构成 so many mistakes；so much 只能修饰不可数名词。
drills.trap: such many 是把 such 当作通用强调词的结果，such 后面必须直接跟名词短语，不能跟 many。

drills.stem: It was ___ a moving film that many in the audience wept.
accept: such
drills.hint: 空后是 a + 形容词 + 名词。
drills.explain: 空后紧跟 a moving film 这一名词短语，需要 such 构成 such a moving film that；若用 so 则须改为 so moving a film。

drills.stem: There were such many visitors that the museum had to close early.
drills.answer: There were so many visitors that the museum had to close early.
accept: There were so many visitors that the museum had to close early.
drills.explain: many 是数量限定词，只能被 so 修饰，构成 so many visitors；such 不能与 many 直接搭配。

drills.stem: 他跑得那么快，没人能追上他。
drills.answer: He ran so fast that nobody could catch up with him.
drills.explain: fast 是副词，只能被 so 修饰，构成 so fast that；such 后面必须出现名词。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: It was such a heavy box that nobody could lift it.
drills.explain: such 修饰 a heavy box 这一名词短语，that 引导结果从句，could 在此表能力而非目的。

items.title: 条件状语从句
items.brief: unless 已含否定，条件从句用现在时表将来

concept.summary: 条件从句按条件的性质选连词：if 引出一般条件；unless 是唯一的否定条件，等于 if...not；provided that 与 on condition that 引出“只有……才”的书面条件；as long as 引出“只要”的必要条件；in case 引出“以防”的预防条件。所有真实条件从句都用一般现在时或现在完成时表将来，不用 will。

sections.p: 先判断条件是“满足即可”“只有才”“只要”还是“以防”，再选连词。unless 与 if 的否定形式等价，但语气更书面，且从句本身不能再出现否定。
bullets: if：一般条件；unless = if not，从句不再带 not
provided that / on condition that：只有……才，书面语
as long as / so long as：只要，强调必要条件
in case：以防，从句可用 should 或一般现在时

sections.p: 条件从句指将来时用一般现在时，主句才用 will。unless 已经包含否定，若从句再写 not，就会出现“除非你不……”的双重否定，逻辑反转。
bullets: √ Unless you book in advance, you will not get a seat.
× Unless you don't book in advance, you will not get a seat.
现在完成时表“先完成”：If you have finished, you may leave.

sections.p: 主语与主句一致且谓语是 be 时，条件从句可省略主语和 be，形成 if necessary、if possible、if any 等固定形式。若 if 从句用 were 或过去式，则属于虚拟语气，表示与事实相反，不在真实条件范围内。
bullets: If necessary, you can reach me at home.
If I were you, I would apologize.（虚拟，用 were）
if only 表愿望，不表条件

examples.en: If you finish the report today, we can submit it tomorrow.
examples.zh: 如果你今天写完报告，我们明天就能提交。
examples.note: if 引导真实条件从句，用一般现在时 finish 表将来。

examples.en: Unless you book in advance, you will not get a seat.
examples.zh: 除非你提前预订，否则订不到位子。
examples.note: unless 本身等于 if not，从句用肯定形式，主句是否定结果。

examples.en: As long as the temperature stays above zero, the pipes will not freeze.
examples.zh: 只要温度保持在零度以上，水管就不会冻住。
examples.note: as long as 引出必要条件，从句用现在时 stays。

examples.en: You may borrow my bike provided that you return it by Sunday.
examples.zh: 只要你周日之前还回来，就可以借我的自行车。
examples.note: provided that 表“只有……才”，书面语中常替代 if。

examples.en: If necessary, you can reach me at home.
examples.zh: 如果有必要，你可以打家里电话找我。
examples.note: if necessary 是 if it is necessary 的省略形式，主语与主句一致。

examples.en: Unless you do not hurry, you will miss the train.
examples.zh: 除非你不快点，否则会误车。
examples.note: unless 已含否定，再加 do not 构成双重否定，应改为 Unless you hurry。

examples.en: If it will snow tomorrow, the flight will be delayed.
examples.zh: 如果明天下雪，航班会延误。
examples.note: 条件从句不能用 will 表将来，应改为 If it snows tomorrow。

pitfalls.wrong: Unless you do not work hard, you will fail.
pitfalls.right: Unless you work hard, you will fail.
pitfalls.why: unless 等于 if not，已经承担否定；从句再否定一次，逻辑会反转成“如果你不努力才失败”。

pitfalls.wrong: If it will rain tomorrow, we will cancel the trip.
pitfalls.right: If it rains tomorrow, we will cancel the trip.
pitfalls.why: 真实条件从句用一般现在时表将来，will 只保留在主句。

pitfalls.wrong: We will start on time provided that everyone will arrive.
pitfalls.right: We will start on time provided that everyone arrives.
pitfalls.why: provided that 与 if 同为条件从句连词，同样要求从句用现在时表将来。

contrast.diff: 连词章节解决“选哪个词表哪种条件”；本点解决从句内部的时态降级、unless 的双重否定与省略形式。

concept.mnemonic: unless 自带 not，从句不再否定；条件讲将来，从句退回现在时。

core: if 表一般条件；unless = if not，从句不再带 not
provided that / on condition that 表“只有……才”，书面语
as long as 表“只要”，in case 表“以防”
条件从句用一般现在时或现在完成时表将来，主句用 will
省略形式：if necessary / if possible / if any
if 从句用 were 或过去式时属虚拟语气
review.trigger: 看到 if / unless / provided that → 先把从句谓语降为现在时 → 再检查 unless 从句是否多了一个 not

quickCheck.q: Unless you ___ (hurry), you will be late. 填什么？
quickCheck.a: hurry。unless 已含否定，从句用肯定形式。

quickCheck.q: If it ___ (rain) tomorrow, we will stay at home. 填什么？
quickCheck.a: rains。条件从句用一般现在时表将来。

quickCheck.q: if necessary 是什么的省略？
quickCheck.a: if it is necessary。

drills.stem: ___ you practise every day, you will not make real progress.
drills.explain: 主句是否定结果 you will not make progress，从句需要“除非”的否定条件，只有 unless 能承担这一意义。
drills.trap: If 与 as long as 都表肯定条件，与主句的否定结果连用会变成“如果每天练习就没进步”，逻辑相反。

drills.stem: You can use my laptop ___ you do not change any settings.
drills.explain: 句意是“只要你不改动任何设置”，从句本身已带否定，需要肯定条件的 as long as；unless 再加否定会双重否定。
drills.trap: unless 与 do not 连用是典型的双重否定错误，会让条件反转成“除非你不改设置”。

drills.stem: If ___, the nurse will call you at home.
accept: necessary
drills.hint: if + 形容词，省略了主语和 be 动词。
drills.explain: if necessary 是 if it is necessary 的省略形式，主语与主句一致时可省略 it is，只保留形容词。

drills.stem: Unless you do not take notes, you will forget the details.
drills.answer: Unless you take notes, you will forget the details.
accept: Unless you take notes, you will forget the details.
drills.explain: unless 已含否定，等于 if you do not take notes；从句再用 do not 构成双重否定，逻辑反转，删去 do not 即可。

drills.stem: 只要你提前预订，就能买到便宜的机票。
drills.answer: As long as you book in advance, you can get cheap air tickets.
drills.explain: as long as 引导必要条件，从句用一般现在时 book 表将来，主句用 can get 表能力与结果。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: Unless it rains, the ceremony will be held outdoors.
drills.explain: unless 从句用一般现在时 rains 表将来，主句用 will be held，构成主将从现加被动语态的组合。

items.title: 让步状语从句
items.brief: 让步靠倒装与 wh-ever，两个连词不能叠加

concept.summary: 让步从句承认一个与预期相反的情况，主句不再用 but。引导词分三类：although/though/even though 承认事实，even if 承认假设；as/though 引导让步必须倒装，把表语、状语或动词原形提到句首；no matter wh- 与 wh-ever 表“无论”，其中 no matter wh- 只能引导状语从句，wh-ever 还能引导主语从句和宾语从句。

sections.h: as/though 倒装让步的三条公式
sections.p: as 引导让步时不能按正常语序写，必须把被强调的成分提到 as 之前，形成“表语/状语/动词原形 + as + 主语 + 谓语”。though 可用同一倒装，although 不能。
bullets: 表语提前：Child as he is, he knows a lot.（单数可数名词前省冠词）
状语提前：Hard as she tried, she could not persuade him. / Much as I like it, I cannot afford it.
动词原形提前：Try as he might, he could not open the door.（谓语含 might/may）
比较：Although he is a child, he knows a lot.（although 不倒装）

sections.h: no matter wh- 与 wh-ever 的分工
sections.p: 两者在状语从句中可互换，但 wh-ever 还能充当主语、宾语，no matter wh- 不能。判断方法：把这个短语从原位置拿掉，句子是否还缺一个成分；缺，就说明它在句中作成分，只能用 wh-ever。
bullets: 状语从句：No matter what happens, stay calm. = Whatever happens, stay calm.
主语从句：Whatever he said was true.（× No matter what he said was true.）
宾语从句：I will take whatever you give me.（× ...no matter what you give me）

sections.p: 英语一个分句只能有一个引导词。although 与 but、though 与 yet 都是中英对译造成的重复标记；whether...or 表让步时也不能再加 although。
bullets: × Although it was raining, but we went out.
√ Although it was raining, we went out. / It was raining, but we went out.
whether...or：Whether you like it or not, the rule applies.

examples.en: Although the task was difficult, they finished it on time.
examples.zh: 尽管任务很难，他们还是按时完成了。
examples.note: although 承认既成事实，主句不再加 but。

examples.en: Child as he is, he can solve the problem on his own.
examples.zh: 尽管他是个孩子，他也能独立解决这个问题。
examples.note: 表语 child 提到 as 之前构成倒装让步，单数可数名词前省去冠词。

examples.en: Hard as she tried, she could not persuade him.
examples.zh: 尽管她努力劝说，还是没能说服他。
examples.note: 副词 hard 提至句首，构成“状语 + as + 主谓”的倒装让步。

examples.en: No matter where you go, you will find this brand.
examples.zh: 无论你走到哪里，都会看到这个品牌。
examples.note: no matter where 引导让步状语从句，可换成 wherever。

examples.en: Whatever he said at the meeting surprised everyone.
examples.zh: 他在会上说的话让所有人都感到意外。
examples.note: whatever 在此作主语从句的引导词并在从句中作 said 的宾语，不能换成 no matter what。

examples.en: Try as he might, he could not open the door.
examples.zh: 尽管他使劲试，还是打不开门。
examples.note: 动词原形 try 提至句首，谓语含 might，构成倒装让步。

examples.en: Although he was tired, but he kept working.
examples.zh: 尽管他很累，还是继续工作。
examples.note: although 与 but 不能同时标记同一转折关系，删去 but。

examples.en: No matter what he said was true.
examples.zh: 他说的话是真的。
examples.note: 此处从句作主语，只能用 Whatever he said was true.；no matter what 只能引导状语从句。

pitfalls.wrong: Although it was raining, but we went out.
pitfalls.right: Although it was raining, we went out.
pitfalls.why: although 是从属连词，but 是并列连词，同一转折关系只需一个标记，叠加会造成分句结构重复。

pitfalls.wrong: As he is a child, he knows a lot about stars.
pitfalls.right: Child as he is, he knows a lot about stars.
pitfalls.why: as 引导让步必须把表语提到句首构成倒装；不倒装时 as 只能表原因“因为”，句意随之改变。

pitfalls.wrong: No matter what you do is fine with me.
pitfalls.right: Whatever you do is fine with me.
pitfalls.why: no matter what 只能引导状语从句，无法在句中充当主语；此处需要能作主语的 wh-ever 结构。

contrast.diff: 倒装章节处理语序操作本身（表语、状语、动词原形前置）；本点处理让步语义的三类引导词分工与 no matter wh- 的适用边界。

concept.mnemonic: 让步不倒装不是让步；no matter 只做状语，wh-ever 才能当主语宾语。

core: although/though/even though 承认事实，even if 承认假设，主句不再加 but
as/though 让步必须倒装：表语/状语/动词原形 + as + 主语 + 谓语
倒装时单数可数名词作表语省冠词：Child as he is
no matter wh- 只能引导状语从句
wh-ever 既可引导状语从句（= no matter wh-），也可引导主语、宾语从句
whether...or 也可表让步
review.trigger: 看到 as 或 though 后面语序反常 → 先确认是不是倒装让步 → 再看 no matter 是否被误用为句子成分

quickCheck.q: “尽管他是个孩子”用 as 怎么写？
quickCheck.a: Child as he is，表语提前且不加冠词。

quickCheck.q: No matter what he said was true. 错在哪里？
quickCheck.a: no matter what 只能引导状语从句，此处是主语从句，应用 Whatever。

quickCheck.q: although 后面能再加 but 吗？
quickCheck.a: 不能。同一转折关系只能有一个连接词。

drills.stem: ___ the journey was exhausting, they arrived in high spirits.
drills.explain: 空后是完整的主谓结构 the journey was exhausting，需要从属连词 although 引导让步状语从句。
drills.trap: Despite 是介词，后面只能接名词性成分；However 是连接副词，必须另起分句并用逗号隔开。

drills.stem: Hard ___ he tried, he could not solve the puzzle.
drills.explain: 副词 hard 已提到句首，构成倒装让步，只有 as 能插在提前的表语或状语与主语之间。
drills.trap: although 引导让步时用正常语序且不能倒装；because 表原因，与“尽管”的语义相反。

drills.stem: ___ as he is, he knows a great deal about astronomy.
accept: Child
drills.hint: 表语提前构成倒装让步，单数可数名词前不用冠词。
drills.explain: child 作表语提到 as 之前，冠词 a 必须省去，写成 Child as he is；若保留冠词则倒装结构不成立。

drills.stem: Although the weather was bad, but the match went on.
drills.answer: Although the weather was bad, the match went on.
accept: Although the weather was bad, the match went on.
The weather was bad, but the match went on.
drills.explain: although 与 but 分别是从属连词和并列连词，同一转折关系只能保留一个，删去 but 后主从结构完整。

drills.stem: ___ he promised turned out to be an empty promise.
drills.explain: 空格所在部分是整个句子的主语，需要一个能引导主语从句并在从句中作 promised 宾语的词，what 同时满足这两个条件。
drills.trap: No matter what 只能引导状语从句，不能充当主语；that 引导主语从句时不在从句中作成分，promised 会缺宾语。

drills.stem: 尽管他是个孩子，他却懂很多天文知识。
drills.answer: Child as he is, he knows a lot about astronomy.
forbid: although he is a child, but
drills.explain: as 引导让步必须倒装，表语 child 提至句首并省去冠词；主句不再加 but，避免两个转折标记叠加。

items.title: 方式与比较状语从句
items.brief: as 表方式不能加 what，比较对象必须对等

concept.summary: 方式从句由 as、as if/as though、the way 引导，说明主句动作是“怎样”做的，从句中与主句相同的成分常被省略；比较从句由 as...as、than、the more...the more 引导，比较对象必须同类对等。两条判据各管一边：as 从句看它是否已在从句中充当成分（充当就不能再加 what），比较从句看 than 前后是否同一个范畴。

sections.p: as 在方式从句中既是连词又是从句的一个成分，常作 say、do、leave 的宾语或状语，因此后面不能再加 what。从句中与主句重复的成分可以省略，形成 as it is、as before 这类固定形式。
bullets: Do as the instructions say.（as 作 say 的宾语）
Leave the room as it is.（as it is = 保持原样）
the way (that) 也可引导方式从句：He did it the way his father did.

sections.h: as if / as though 的语气
sections.p: as if 从句的语气由事实决定：可能是真的，用陈述语气；与事实相反，用虚拟语气（be 用 were，过去的假设用 had done）。判断依据是说话人是否认为它成立。
bullets: It looks as if it is going to rain.（很可能下，陈述语气）
He acted as if nothing had happened.（与过去事实相反，用 had done）
She talks as if she knew everything.（与现在事实相反，用过去式）

sections.h: 比较从句的对等与省略
sections.p: than 与 as...as 后面接的是从句，可省略与主句重复的部分。省略后留下的名词必须与前面的比较对象同类：人口比人口，气候比气候，否则要用 that of / those of 补出范畴。
bullets: × The climate here is milder than Beijing.
√ The climate here is milder than that of Beijing.
the more..., the more...：前后两个分句都要用“the + 比较级 + 主谓”的语序

examples.en: Do as the instructions say.
examples.zh: 按说明书上说的做。
examples.note: as 引导方式从句，并在从句中作 say 的宾语，因此不能再加 what。

examples.en: Leave the room as it is.
examples.zh: 让房间保持原样。
examples.note: as it is 是方式从句的固定省略形式，表示“照现在的样子”。

examples.en: He acted as if nothing had happened.
examples.zh: 他表现得好像什么都没发生过。
examples.note: 与过去事实相反，as if 从句用过去完成时。

examples.en: The more you practise, the more confident you become.
examples.zh: 你练习得越多，就越自信。
examples.note: the + 比较级引导两个分句，前为条件、后为结果，语序均为陈述语序。

examples.en: The service here is better than that of the hotel across the street.
examples.zh: 这里的服务比街对面那家旅馆的好。
examples.note: 用 that of 补出比较范畴，避免把 service 与 hotel 直接相比。

examples.en: Do as what the teacher tells you.
examples.zh: 按老师说的做。
examples.note: as 已在从句中作 tells 的宾语，再加 what 会造成宾语重复，应改为 Do as the teacher tells you.

examples.en: He spoke as if he has been there before.
examples.zh: 他说话的口气好像以前去过那里。
examples.note: 与过去事实相反，as if 从句须用过去完成时 had been，不能用现在完成时。

pitfalls.wrong: Do as what the teacher tells you.
pitfalls.right: Do as the teacher tells you.
pitfalls.why: as 兼作从句中 tells 的宾语，再加 what 会出现两个宾语，结构重叠。

pitfalls.wrong: He spoke as if he has been there before.
pitfalls.right: He spoke as if he had been there before.
pitfalls.why: as if 从句表示与过去事实相反，须用过去完成时把假设时间前移一层。

pitfalls.wrong: The climate here is milder than Beijing.
pitfalls.right: The climate here is milder than that of Beijing.
pitfalls.why: than 前后必须是同类事物，气候不能与城市相比，须用 that of 补出所属范畴。

contrast.diff: as...as 章节处理形容词、副词同级比较的构成与修饰语位置；本点处理 as 引导的方式从句（是否作成分）与 than 引导的比较从句（对等与省略）。

concept.mnemonic: as 已在句中作成分，就别再塞 what；比较要对等，范畴不同加 that of。

core: as 方式从句：表“按照、像”，as 本身在从句中充当成分
as 后不能加 what，否则宾语重复
as if/as though：可能为真用陈述语气，与事实相反用虚拟
比较从句：than、as...as 后可省略与主句重复的部分
比较对象必须对等，不同范畴用 that of / those of
the more..., the more... 前后都用陈述语序
review.trigger: 看到 as 引导从句 → 先看 as 在从句里作不作成分 → 再判断 as if 从句该用陈述还是虚拟

quickCheck.q: Do as what I say. 错在哪里？
quickCheck.a: as 已作 say 的宾语，what 多余，应改为 Do as I say.

quickCheck.q: as if 从句什么时候用 had done？
quickCheck.a: 表示与过去事实相反时。

quickCheck.q: “这里的气候比北京温和”怎么说？
quickCheck.a: The climate here is milder than that of Beijing.

drills.stem: Do ___ the instructions say, and you will not go wrong.
drills.explain: 空后是完整从句 the instructions say，需要 as 引导方式从句，as 同时作 say 的宾语，表示“按照说明书所说的做”。
drills.trap: like 是介词，只能接名词性成分，不能引导从句；what 会与 as 的宾语功能重复。

drills.stem: He speaks ___ he had witnessed the whole accident.
accept: as if
as though
drills.hint: 表“好像”，后面的 had witnessed 说明与过去事实相反。
drills.explain: 从句用过去完成时，说明是与过去事实相反的假设，需要 as if 或 as though 引出虚拟语气的方式从句。

drills.stem: He spoke as if he has been to Paris many times.
drills.answer: He spoke as if he had been to Paris many times.
accept: He spoke as if he had been to Paris many times.
drills.explain: 主句是过去时 spoke，as if 从句表示与过去事实相反的假设，须用过去完成时 had been，把假设时间前移一层。

drills.stem: The service in this hotel is far better than ___ in the one across the street.
drills.explain: 比较对象是 service，是不可数名词，用 that 替代前面提到的同类事物，构成 the service...than that in...的对等比较。
drills.trap: it 指同一个事物，而此处是两家旅馆各自的服务，不是同一个；those 只能替代复数名词。

drills.stem: 他说起话来好像他亲眼见过这件事。
drills.answer: He talks as if he had seen it with his own eyes.
drills.explain: as if 引导方式从句表与事实相反的假设，用过去完成时 had seen；as if 后不能再接 what，因为它已在从句中充当连接成分。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: The more you practise, the more confident you become.
drills.explain: the more 引导的两个分句都用陈述语序，前一分句表条件，后一分句表随之而来的结果。
